title: Built a war game with Google Ai Studio
author: redditissocoolyoyo
selftext:
Built this game with Google Ai Studio. I guess you can say I Yolo mode it. Looks awesome. But I have no idea how to play. Building a game is hard. It takes thought and a process. My first game. Try it out. Yes I can click a bunch of buttons. But it doesn't make any sense.

  
[https://military-strategy-logistics-simulator-788501826526.us-west2.run.app/](https://military-strategy-logistics-simulator-788501826526.us-west2.run.app/)

comments.author: DeathStarVet
comments.body: This whole post, and game, is truly awful.

comments.author: Kingnorik
comments.body: I'm a staunch defender of AI game dev, but even you don't know how to play it yet you still decided to post this?

replies.author: redditissocoolyoyo
replies.body: Yes. I'm new to this. So I am throwing it out there for some constructive and critical feedback.

replies.author: BoredzzzGame
replies.body: Feedback is figure out what you want to do then make a GDD. Use that to guide your model. Break down each task. This is just straight up sloppyware. It’s gross. Do better.

replies.author: redditissocoolyoyo
replies.body: That's good feedback. Thanks man. Breaking down the tasks make a lot of sense.

comments.author: Veilkam
comments.body:
You didn't built anything if you don't even know how to play your "own" game?

Did you made any game design decisions or just told the AI to built a strategy game?

replies.author: redditissocoolyoyo
replies.body: I just yolo it. But game design decisions. That's a good place to start. I'm completely new to game building. Thanks for that tip. I will start there. Much appreciated.

replies.author: Veilkam
replies.body: What do you mean by yolo?

comments.author: Prior-Meeting1645
comments.body: Was this made totally in google ai studio? I didn’t think its capable of such visuals for the menu etc

replies.author: redditissocoolyoyo
replies.body: Yes. 100% Google AI studio. Just prompting it like mad. I'm taking the other people's feedback and starting out by thinking about the game play design and then breaking down each task. No more yolo.

comments.author: Rensuto
comments.body: If you don't care about your game, why should we?

replies.author: redditissocoolyoyo
replies.body: I care. I care a lot. Like I care about you too.
